tests.detail: Full suite passed before review and after the passage repair; includes HTTP integration, provider protocol fixtures and actual sandboxed 2D/3D renders.

repairs.problem: Late suggestions replaced a highlighted text leaf, collapsing the painted passage while the question stayed open.
repairs.evidenceBefore: Focused built-UI delayed-suggestion regression failed with an empty range instead of latch.
repairs.fix: Rebuild the CSS Highlight in a layout effect when reply leaves change.
repairs.evidenceAfter: 16 passage-popup checks passed, including delayed suggestions, draft/focus and Escape in dark desktop/light narrow.

repairs.problem: Request-failure browser check included an internal screen-reader-only status node and rejected the safe inline-video reason.
repairs.fix: Measure the visible status and Retry, wait for an unobscured stage before screenshots, and assert the server-authored validation reason.

repairs.problem: Visual-branch keyboard check sometimes raced Escape focus restoration or an OOPIF event result.
repairs.fix: Wait for restored frame focus and Round two before asserting.
repairs.evidenceAfter: Two consecutive final runs passed all seven groups.

repairs.problem: Video-library default native fixture referenced an expired temporary database.
repairs.fix: Use a copy of this run real-render fixture; seek relative to short duration and record input provenance.
repairs.evidenceAfter: Migration, playback/seek, source deletion, both appearances and zero inference passed.

review.spec: Sole confirmed passage-highlight finding repaired and verified.
review.sandboxProbe: Additional ready hostile visual attempted self-navigation with a dynamically constructed URL to a separate loopback sink. Attempt/return markers confirmed execution; zero sink requests; frame stayed opaque and ready.

existingNativeEvidence.scope: Previously completed gated native tutor + smart-worker render/interaction, inspected in this run. No fresh inference claimed.
existingNativeEvidence.claude: docs/verification/visual-native-claude.json records the earlier quota failure; no live Claude visual claimed.
